predecessors.text: Northern Rhodesia: 'The territory of Zambia was known as "Northern Rhodesia" from 1911 to 1964'

ledger.x: 24 October 1964: Northern Rhodesia becomes the independent Republic of Zambia under Kenneth Kaunda.
